status: provisional — requires Thomas's acceptance before implementation resumes
statement: Selective Intelligence turns minimal user intent into a complete, evidence-grounded product by understanding intent FIRST, discovering every machine-available fact, asking only what it cannot safely discover, and executing every runnable step with the capabilities the user already has — continuing until the product is verified-complete or genuine human action is the only remaining blocker. Platynum-47 is the user-facing product and control environment for this process; SI is the intelligence and execution system underneath it. They are one product; drift in either is an SI failure.
invariants: Authority order: explicit user intent > later explicit corrections > confirmed facts > accepted acceptance criteria > architecture > existing code. Code is evidence of current state, never of desired state.

Intent gate: no planning/implementation begins until confirmed intent, derived interpretation, reversible assumptions, unresolved contradictions, and missing human decisions are distinguished (I018/I019).
Capability-first: SI discovers and uses whatever the user already has authenticated; no global model-key requirement; a missing capability blocks only the dependent lane (I023).
Minimal human layer: user only answers material questions, takes alignment/authority steps, connects their own sources, or performs human-only actions (I014).
A new instruction triggers intent reconciliation + contradiction detection + impact analysis + invalidation + queue regeneration — not a task append (I025).
The prompt queue is an inbox; intent/fact/acceptance/dependency ledgers are authoritative; execution queues are derived (I025).
Completion requires evidence against accepted product acceptance criteria; code existing/compiling/committing is not completion (I025).
Plain, numbered, non-developer presentation of plans; no jargon on user surfaces (I003/I017).
Every durable work product is timestamped and time-aware (I011).
